alice: Hey folks — quick Q&A. I noticed sporadic partial JSON decode errors in our Python SSE client when traffic spikes. Example: got a chunk with '{"choices":[{"delta":' and then connection continued. Anyone seen this?

sam: yep saw similar in staging yesterday. stack: aiohttp + our incremental decoder. usually fixed by buffering until `\n\n` or `data: [DONE]`.

priya: can you paste snippet of how you're reading from stream?

alice: ```
async with session.get(url, headers=headers) as resp:
    async for chunk in resp.content.iter_chunked(1024):
        buf += chunk.decode()
        while '\n\n' in buf:
            msg, buf = buf.split('\n\n', 1)
            process(ndjson_to_json(msg))
```
getting JSONDecodeError: Expecting ',' delimiter

kim: that pattern is fragile for multibyte utf8 emojis — split can cut a codepoint. also if SSE uses `data:` prefixes we need to strip them. Try using incremental JSON parser (json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode) with exception handling.

sam: also check `resp.content.iter_any()`? Another idea: rely on newline-delimited JSON where we parse only on complete object braces — e.g. count open/close braces; unsafe but works if payloads are single objects.

priya: backpressure angle: are consumer coroutines falling behind? If event arrival rate > processing rate, buffer grows and chunks get concatenated mid-object. We should add flow control: await queue.put with maxsize and have producer await when full.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: noticed rate-limit spikes at 2026-03-16T14:03Z impacting 3 requests/s for this key :warning: 

alice: thanks — we do see latency spikes at those times. implementing a bounded asyncio.Queue helped in local repro.

kim: small helper pattern:
```
decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
buffer = ""
def feed(s):
    nonlocal buffer
    buffer += s
    while buffer.strip():
        try:
            obj, idx = decoder.raw_decode(buffer)
            process(obj)
            buffer = buffer[idx:].lstrip()
        except ValueError:
            break
```
handle UTF-8 boundaries by accumulating bytes and decode only on valid slices.

sam: also add a retry policy: if decoder fails with ValueError for > 500ms, drop connection and reconnect with backoff. logs to check: SSE chunk sizes, resp.headers.get('transfer-encoding')

alice: creating GH issue and PR. quick ask: can someone review flow-control PR? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/234

priya: I'll review tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
